book.name: MUNIJE AMA AKARI
book.title: Amisye Po MUNIJE AMA AKARI RARORON Irati Yohanes Ai

content: Yohanes po Amisye aen no munijo ntiti

Naije akato risyo ana inta raen akato: Tugae rave, unsanda inta rapaya no munijo ntiti warae. Umba anamote inta ngkin akato, omamo anamoto idanaun to arono wusyinoe, ama kine maisyare tavuna Amisye ramaisy, mo raura mare: “Winandesen no so, Syo ana inta rarorono nai, ana indati mare nande kobe rai.”
Naije kobe Anawayo Vambunine mo inausuru tenambe, ti syo kursijo titi inta raen no munijo ntiti muno kursije umaso Vatane inta tuna rai.

Vatano tuna kursijo titi umaso rai opamo amune mba dave maisyare oramo mamani ntumbeowe ama mangke nseo rave. Umba kursijo titi umaso mamo eve ngkaipi dai, ngkenav maisyare oramo ama ntumbe njayaibe ramaisy.

Umba kursijo kaijinta ama manui ma tenamara eane mambisy nsasaiyo kursijo titi umaso rakiani, muno vatano ube akarive inta nawirati utantuna rai. Wo ansuno mpopere rave vintabo muno wo sapeo emasije raijasea ntuna makari vone rai.

Nai kursijo titi umaso rai ivak akokoe ratatukande muno katitire ravabari mo nuge rambayar tenambe. Muno kursijo titi ama usye umaso rai yawainye kaururum, wemirati mbadurur kobe no naije. Wemamo Amisye apa anawayo vambunino kaururumo wemije.

Naije tavon kursijo titi umaso ama usye mamo maisyare nawanano ndandini dave, maisyare kansina wemaisy. Muno ana akokoe Amisye po manari inta yano mambisy usayai no kursijo titi umawe rakijani. Onawamo mamije manui no makijani tenambe, weti no mamune rai muno no makiri rai tenambe tavon.

Ana akokoe Amisye po manari umaso inta maisyare singa amaisy, jirume pamo maisyare sapijo anya amaisy, mandeije pamo amune mo vatane mansamaisy, umba mambisye pamo maisyare insani mangkangkan badirir amaisy.

Ana mambisye umawe nawamo nanentabo awa pepake nande mansai. Inta apa pepake nanto no kawije intabo. Ranijo makasyo no uga mamo mansami no rai tenambe. Namane rinit ukiny tutir, wo Amisye ararimbe ware,

content.text: Nya vambunine ntiti mo vambunino kaijo rui rakivan tenambe!
Winyamo wusyinoe no to muno Winya soamo no kobe,
muno Winya nugo makare umu no tutir!”

content: Ana mambisye umawe nanao wo ransyerano ngkangkamane raijaseo Amisye ai, wo aura titive, muno wo kove raura seo Ai, napi tuna no kursijo titi rai, Opi kova noa nuge nuganui. Arono ana mambisy umaso ware usambayambe tai maisy,

weamo vatano ube akarive mansano tenamara eane mambisy umawe wo vukane ranteter, ubeaje irati Napi tuna no kursijo titi raije Ai, opirati kova noa nuge nuganui. Naije wo awa sapeo rapapaya, wo raugaje ntuna no kursijo titi ama usye, wo raura ware:

content.text: Nyo ranari mamaisyo Nya bekere obo rai.
Maisyare omai ti, Wibuin nyirati mamai dave,
weti reamo nararimbe, Nya kove ntiti rave,
Winyirati wimbe akarive nuge so rai tenambe!”
